# odyssey-110 — new renderings (not in the conventions table)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τοῖσι δὲ Τηλέμαχος πεπνυμένος ἦρχ’ ἀγορεύειν (22.461, whole-line speech introduction; `ἦρχε` + infinitive) | "And among them prudent Telemachus began to speak:" | "And prudent Telemachus was the first to speak among them:" | "addressed" (reserved for προσέφη), "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο); shaped like the table's τοῖσι δὲ μύθων ἦρχε Γερήνιος ἱππότα Νέστωρ |
| θόλος (22.442, 459, 466) | "the round house" (note: a tholos, a circular building; use not stated) | "the round house" | "rotunda", "dome", "vault", "tholos" (leaves the word untranslated) |
| ξίφος τανύηκες (22.443, ξίφεσιν τανυήκεσιν) | "long-edged swords" (+ note: second element usually taken as ἀκή 'point, edge'; not certain) | "long-edged swords" | "long-pointed", "sharp" (reserved for ὀξύς), "long-bladed" (silently picks one guess) |
| εὐερκὴς αὐλή (22.449, αὐλῆς εὐερκέος) | "well-fenced" | "well-fenced courtyard" | "strongly walled", "well-enclosed"; εὖ + ἕρκος, "fence", as in ἕρκος ὀδόντων |
| ἕρκος (of a bird-net, 22.469, ἕρκει ἐνιπλήξωσι) | "net" (+ note: ἕρκος is normally a fence or enclosure) | "net" | "snare", "trap", "fence" (the other senses are kept for the other uses of ἕρκος) |
| αἶνα ὀλοφυρόμεναι (22.447, αἴν’ ὀλοφυρόμεναι) | "fearsomely wailing" | "wailing bitterly" | "terribly" (taken by δεινός / σχέτλιος), "dreadfully" (δεινός "dreadful"), "grievously" (ἀργαλέος); αἰνός keeps "fearsome" in `l` |
| μοῖρα θεῶν (22.413, μοῖρ’ ἐδάμασσε θεῶν) | "the portion of the gods" | "what the gods had portioned out" | "fate" (reserved for the μοῖρ’ ὀλοή row's "the deadly fate"), "destiny", "doom" (reserved for πότμος) |
| ἀναιδείη (22.424, ἀναιδείης ἐπέβησαν) | "shamelessness" | "shamelessness" ("gone the way of shamelessness") | "insolence", "impudence"; the noun of the table's ἀναιδής "shameless" |
| νηλείτις (22.418, αἳ νηλείτιδές εἰσιν) | "guiltless" | "guiltless" | "innocent", "blameless" (reserved for ἀμύμων) |
| λίστρον (22.455, λίστροισιν) | "shovels" | "shovels" | "scrapers", "hoes", "spades" |
| θειόω / θεειόω (22.482 θεειώσω, 22.494 διεθείωσεν; the verb of θέειον "sulphur") | "fumigate" | "fumigate" | "purify" (not what the verb says), "cleanse" (reserved for καθαίρω), "burn sulphur in" |
| ἄνωχθι / ἄνωχθε (22.437, 22.483) | "bid" | "tell … to" | "order", "command" (reserved for κελεύω / ἐκέλευσε), "urge" (reserved for ὀτρύνω) |
| κίχλαι · πέλειαι (22.468) | "thrushes" · "doves" | "thrushes" · "doves" | "larks", "pigeons" |
| ἀμφιχέομαι (22.498, ἀμφεχέοντο) | "poured themselves around" | "threw themselves round" | "embraced", "crowded round" |
| νεμεσσητόν (22.489) | "a thing to resent" | "a thing to resent" | "improper", "shameful"; follows the table's νεμεσσάω "felt resentment at" |
